name: @rcweston/credits
description: Credits as data, checked in CI: a build fails when a dependency isn't credited.
author: Charlie Weston

scripts.self-check: pnpm build && node bin/credits-check.mjs --config ../../credits.config.mjs --package package.json --package packages/credits/package.json --package packages/save-kit/package.json --package packages/xray/package.json --package packages/story-core/package.json --package packages/story-server/package.json --package packages/story-react/package.json --package packages/story-editor/package.json --package apps/demo/package.json
